draft.content:
We provide the following records in response to this dispute. The customer claims they did not receive the ticket email and contacted support before the event [case_atm_1043:dispute]. Payment was captured for order ATM-1043 [case_atm_1043:payment]. The order contains one general-admission ticket to Warehouse Sessions [case_atm_1043:order]. The ticket was issued in the application, but there is no recorded customer acknowledgement of access [case_atm_1043:ticket]. The initial confirmation email to the customer bounced due to a permanent mailbox error [case_atm_1043:email]. A ticket-link SMS also failed to deliver [case_atm_1043:sms]. After the customer reported the missing delivery, the organizer requested a resend [case_atm_1043:resend][case_atm_1043:support-1][case_atm_1043:support-2]. The resent email also bounced [case_atm_1043:retry].

analysis.summary: The customer claims they did not receive the ticket email and contacted support before the event. Records show payment was captured, the ticket was issued, but both email and SMS delivery attempts failed. A resend request was made, and the resent email also bounced. No attendance records or policy terms are available.
analysis.recommendation: Verify if any additional delivery attempts were made or if the customer accessed the ticket through alternative means. Confirm whether the customer's account shows any sign of ticket access or recovery. Review any available scan data for the event to determine attendance.
